definitions.explanation: Something given in recognition of good work, achievement, or effort. Often used for treats or rewards given to children, or as self-reward.

examples.japanese: ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a cake as a reward.
examples.notes: ご{褒美|ほうび} is the polite/common form

examples.japanese: ⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{褒美|ほうび}だ。
examples.english: I worked hard, so this is a reward for myself.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|い}い⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Since the child got good grades, I bought them a toy they liked as a reward.

notes:
{褒美|ほうび} is almost always used with the honorific prefix ご as ご{褒美|ほうび}. Using {褒美|ほうび} without ご sounds old-fashioned or literary.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あげる→あげる：00546_ageru⟧: to give a reward
- ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to receive a reward
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{褒美|ほうび}: a reward for oneself
- ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something as a reward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧: remuneration, compensation (more formal, for work)
- ⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: prize, award (for competitions or achievements)
- ご{褒美|ほうび} has a warm, personal tone and is often used for treats.
